phase: Phase 1 - Proof Triage and CI Alignment
purpose: Turn local proof and CI proof output into a clear triage report that classifies failures, maps each blocker to an owner, gives the next command to run, and keeps sandbox/source-only claims separate from strict professional-candidate proof.

classification_rules.meaning: The gate did not run because a required local or CI tool is missing.
classification_rules.default_next_action: Install the missing toolchain and rerun the strict proof gate.

classification_rules.meaning: The gate executed but returned a failure.
classification_rules.default_next_action: Open the per-gate log, fix the failing command, and rerun the same gate.

classification_rules.meaning: The gate is useful for sandbox confidence but not strict professional proof.
classification_rules.default_next_action: Rerun the equivalent strict command with real external tools.

classification_rules.meaning: A proof report expected by the evidence bundle is missing.
classification_rules.default_next_action: Run the gate that produces the missing report and recollect evidence.

classification_rules.meaning: The gate exceeded the configured timeout before completing.
classification_rules.default_next_action: Increase timeout or run the gate directly to see where it hangs.

classification_rules.meaning: The gate was skipped or filtered out of the run.
classification_rules.default_next_action: Run the omitted gate or remove the filter.

next_command_map.typescript-api: cd api && npm ci && npm run ci:api

ci_alignment.local_to_ci_rule: Every strict local gate must have a matching CI command or a documented source-only CI fallback with a professional-readiness caveat.

phase1_4_exit_criteria: Triage report can be generated from local proof and evidence reports.
Every blocker has a class, severity, owner, next command, and remediation message.
CI alignment checks verify the proof-hardening workflow exists and names required proof jobs.
make v0394-check passes in sandbox/source mode without claiming professional readiness.
